# Hotel Speak

> > Hotel Speak is a hospitality technology and marketing resource covering PMS systems, distribution strategies, and operational insights for hoteliers.

The site features expert insights on hotel technology solutions including Property Management Systems (PMS), channel managers, and distribution platforms. Content focuses on practical strategies for revenue management, direct bookings, guest experience, and partnerships between major hospitality tech providers like Hotelogix, STAAH, and eRevMax.

## Key Topics

- Property Management Systems (PMS)
- Hotel Distribution & Channel Management
- Revenue Management & Yield Optimization
- Direct Bookings vs OTAs
- Hotel Marketing Strategies
- PMS Integration & Technology Partnerships
- Hotelogix & STAAH Solutions
- RateTiger & eRevMax
- Inventory & Rate Management
- Email Marketing & Guest Segmentation
- Video Content Marketing
- COVID-19 Recovery Strategies
- Booking.com & Airbnb Distribution
- Hotel Operations & Guest Experience
- Metasearch & Online Visibility

## Hotel Technology & PMS Solutions

- [How to Choose the Best Property Management System (PMS) for your Hotel](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2017/03/choose-best-property-management-system-pms-hotel): Preno's guide to selecting PMS with channel manager integration tips
- [Hotelogix Partners With eRevMax To Help Hotels With Distribution Effort](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2019/06/hotelogix-partners-with-erevmax-to-help-hotels-with-distribution-effort): Hotelogix PMS integrates with eRevMax's RateTiger channel manager solution
- [Transforming Technological Solutions in Hospitality: AxisRooms-Hotelogix Join Forces to Deliver Exceptional Service](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2021/02/transforming-technological-solutions-in-hospitality-axisrooms-hotelogix-join-forces-to-deliver-exceptional-service): AxisRooms and Hotelogix merge for unified full-stack hotel solutions
- [Hotelogix Enhances Its Hotel PMS With Powerful Features In 2021, Eyes 2x Growth In 2022](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2021/12/hotelogix-enhances-its-hotel-pms-with-powerful-features-in-2021-eyes-2x-growth-in-2022): Hotelogix adds PMS features including CRO 1.0, targets 2x growth in 2022
- [What is Success for a Hotel Concierge? | Software & Guest Satisfaction](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2017/04/what-is-success-hotel-concierge): Erik Rocca on concierge software enabling better guest interactions

## Distribution & Revenue Management

- [5 Effective Distribution Channels To Keep Your Hotel Alive & Competitive](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2019/08/5-effective-distribution-channels-to-keep-your-hotel-alive-competitive): Distribution pillars: social media, website UX, metasearch, channel manager
- [What Should A Hotel Marketing Manager Be Doing To Increase Yield?](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2017/07/hotel-marketing-manager-increase-yield): STAAH guide on revenue management basics: occupancy, pricing, RevPAR, ADR
- [How Small Hotels Can Boost Direct Bookings: Interview with Taylor Short](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2016/10/small-hotels-can-boost-direct-bookings-interview-taylor-short): Software Advice's Taylor Short on direct booking strategies for small hotels
- [How To Make Your Online Travel Agency (OTA) More Successful](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2018/03/how-to-make-your-online-travel-agency-more-successful): Andrew Spektor on OTA success through tech updates and customer retention

## Hotel Marketing & Content Strategy

- [Get, Set, Send - Get The Most Out Of Your Email Marketing](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2017/07/get-set-send-get-most-out-of-email-marketing): STAAH tips for hotel email marketing success with segmentation & PMS tools
- [Why Video Is Crucial For Your Hotel's Success | Hotel Marketing](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2020/01/why-video-is-crucial-for-your-hotels-success): Video marketing strategies for hotels to influence traveler decisions
- [The Rise of Travel Video Content Marketing | Hotel Marketing](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2015/12/the-rise-of-travel-video-content-marketing): Sarah Harkness on video storytelling strategies for travel brands
- [10 Killer Ideas For Your Hotel Blog | Hotel Content Marketing Tips](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2017/08/10-killer-ideas-hotel-blog): STAAH's 10 content ideas for hotel blogs and destination marketing
- [4 Essential Checks for your Hotels Facebook Page](https://www.hotelspeak.com/2015/04/4-essential-checks-hotels-facebook-page): Matt Tutt's 4 essential Facebook page optimization checks for hotels
